title: CreativeScore
description: A reading of one generated piece: how it sat against the voice it was written for, how it fitted the channel it was written into, and why. About a piece of work, never about the person who asked for it — nothing here is said about an actor.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

generation.description: The id of the generated piece this reads, in the system that owns it. A piece of work, not an actor: it has no wallet.

reading.description: What the scorer made of the piece: the two scores, the one carried alongside them, and why.

modelUsed.description: The model that read the piece, as it was named at the time. Recorded so two scores can be told apart when the scorer changed underneath them.

createdAt.description: When the piece was scored, which is not when it was written.
